description: Header file defining the UnitConverterViewModel class and related classes for the calculator application's unit conversion feature, including categories, units, supplementary results, and callbacks.

classes.name: Category
classes.description: Represents a unit conversion category with properties for name and visibility.

classes.name: Unit
classes.description: Represents a unit with properties for name, accessible name, abbreviation, and methods to retrieve model data.

classes.name: SupplementaryResult
classes.description: Represents a supplementary conversion result with value and unit.

classes.name: IActivatable
classes.description: Interface for controls that can be activated or deactivated.

classes.name: Activatable
classes.description: Template class implementing IActivatable for any type with IsActive property.

classes.name: UnitConverterViewModel
classes.description: Main view model class for unit conversion, managing categories, units, results, and user interactions.

methods.name: IsModelUnitWhimsical
methods.description: Checks if the unit is whimsical.

methods.name: GetLocalizedAutomationName
methods.description: Generates a localized automation name string.

methods.name: SaveUserPreferences
methods.description: Saves user preferences for category and units.

methods.name: RestoreUserPreferences
methods.description: Restores user preferences for category and units.

methods.name: OnCurrencyDataLoadFinished
methods.description: Handles completion of currency data load.

methods.name: OnCurrencyTimestampUpdated
methods.description: Updates timestamp info for currency data.

methods.name: UpdateDisplay
methods.description: Updates the display with conversion results.

methods.name: OnMaxDigitsReached
methods.description: Handles scenario when maximum digits are reached.

methods.name: BuildUnitList
methods.description: Builds list of units from model data.

methods.name: FindUnitInList
methods.description: Finds a unit in the current list.

methods.name: SetSelectedUnits
methods.description: Sets the selected units based on preferences.

methods.name: SupplementaryResultsTimerTick
methods.description: Timer tick handler for supplementary results.
